AND, conj. च placed after the word which it connects with
another. In many cases ‘and’ may be omitted in San-
skrit, and the connection expressed by the use of the
indeclinable participle; as, ‘the beasts assembled and
informed the lion,’ पशुभिर्मिलित्वा सिंहो विज्ञप्तः.
— (Moreover)
अपिच, किञ्च, अपरं, अन्यच्च.
— (And then) अथ.
ANDANTE, s. घनं, तत्त्वं, विलम्बितं, स्पष्टं.
